rows.text: Adelphi guarantees a $10,000 annual tuition rate for eligible undergraduate transfer students from New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, and Massachusetts who have at least a 3.6 GPA.
Andrews University serves as the flagship higher education institution of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.

Through the Bryan Nursing Access Program, students complete their first two years tuition-free at Chadron, Peru, or Wayne State College before transferring to Bryan with a guaranteed spot in the BSN program.
The CU Tuition Guarantee covers 100% of tuition for Pell-eligible first-time Kentucky freshmen who have at least a 2.0 high school GPA.
Central State University is Ohio's only public historically Black university and 1890 Land-Grant institution.
Through the Buc Promise program, eligible South Carolina residents are guaranteed 100% tuition coverage through combined federal, state, and institutional aid.

Through the Colby Commitment, Colby meets 100% of demonstrated need without loans. Families earning $75,000 or less with typical assets pay $0, and families earning up to $150,000 pay no more than $15,000.
Through DavisConnects, Colby guarantees all students access to funding for research, internship, and global experiences regardless of their ability to pay.
Every student works on campus 15 hours a week, plus two 40-hour work weeks each school year.
Through the Semester in LA program, Columbia students spend a semester living and studying on a historic studio lot in Los Angeles while earning their degree.

Every Columbia College student takes the Core Curriculum, shared courses including Literature Humanities, Contemporary Civilization, Art and Music Humanities, and Frontiers of Science. It dates to 1919. Engineering students take a shorter version.
Conception Seminary College is an undergraduate Roman Catholic seminary college authorized to grant Bachelor of Arts degrees in Philosophy as well as Philosophical and Theological Studies.
Cottey is a women's college owned by the P.E.O. Sisterhood, an organization of more than 200,000 women who support its students.

Under the D-Plan, the year has four terms including summer. Students are on campus for all of first year, the summer after sophomore year and at least two senior terms, and fit 12 terms into 15, with at most seven fall or spring terms on campus.

Delaware State University offers a four-year, full-tuition Inspire Scholarship to eligible Delaware high school graduates who enroll full time right after graduation with at least a 2.75 cumulative GPA.
The Pirate Promise transfer program provides participating North Carolina community college students guaranteed admission to ECU upon completing an approved associate degree.
Students in the Walsh School of Foreign Service must reach proficiency in a second language to graduate.

The co-op program alternates paid, full-time work semesters with semesters of classes: at least three work terms with the same employer, and you stay enrolled tuition-free while working. Finishing earns a co-op designation on your diploma.
Unlike most selective schools, Georgia Tech requires SAT or ACT scores.
Starting in 2026–27, undergraduates from families earning up to $200,000 pay no tuition, and at $100,000 or less the typical family pays nothing at all.
All residential undergraduate students must complete one Christian Community Service (CSER) credit for each full-time semester, up to eight semesters.
Lincoln University in Pennsylvania is recognized as the nation's first degree-granting Historically Black College and University.
MCLA offers 85% tuition reduction programs for undergraduate students residing in Connecticut, Maine, New Hampshire, New York, Rhode Island, and Vermont.
Traditional undergraduates at MNU must earn 20 Spiritual Formation Credits each semester, including 10 from Tuesday Gathering Chapels.

Under the Lion Pride Tuition Discount, students from every state touching Missouri—Arkansas, Kansas, Oklahoma, Illinois, Iowa, Tennessee, Kentucky, and Nebraska—as well as all counties in Texas, California, Nevada, Arizona, and Florida, pay the same tuition rate as in-state students.
Nazareth offers SPARK Grants of $1,500 to help undergraduate students cover costs for an unpaid or underpaid summer internship, study abroad, or summer research.
Under Newberry College's Tuition Promise, tuition is frozen for incoming first-year students for all four years of their college career.

The Golden Guarantee covers 100% of tuition for four years for incoming Michigan freshmen who receive the Michigan Achievement Scholarship, have family income up to $70,000, and have assets under $50,000.

Under the Columbus Catholic Promise Program, Ohio Dominican University covers remaining tuition and student services fees for Pell-eligible graduates of the Columbus Diocese's 11 high schools after applicable scholarships and aid are applied.
Established in the Fall of 1969, San Francisco State's College of Ethnic Studies was the first program of its kind in the United States.
SC State is South Carolina's only public land-grant historically Black college and university.
Spelman students can take classes at Morehouse and Clark Atlanta through the Atlanta University Center; more than a quarter of AUC students cross-register for at least one course each semester.
The 3+2 Dual Degree Engineering Program pairs three years at Spelman with two at a partner such as Georgia Tech, Michigan, Columbia, Dartmouth or Caltech, ending with two bachelor's degrees.
SUNY Cortland operates educational facilities at Raquette Lake in the Adirondacks, including Camp Huntington, the only National Historic Landmark in the SUNY system.
Founded in 1871, SUNY Geneseo is designated as New York's Public Honors College.
SUNY ESF operates The Ranger School in Wanakena, New York, offering educational programs in the Adirondacks.

Under the Javelina Promise, Texas residents with family income of $100,000 or less and financial need have tuition and mandatory fees covered, starting with new students in fall 2027. The limit was $65,000 for earlier classes.
Every admitted undergraduate gets at least a half-tuition scholarship, and in 2025–26 half of students had their full tuition covered. Cooper Union plans to be fully tuition-free by 2028–29.

Out-of-state freshmen with at least a 3.5 GPA get automatic merit scholarships based on ACT or SAT scores, from $6,000 a year (ACT 25–26) up to $28,000 a year (ACT 32–36), with no separate application. A 36 ACT or 1600 SAT with a 4.0 GPA earns full tuition.
The University of Toccoa Falls is affiliated with the Christian and Missionary Alliance.

Public service is part of the core curriculum: students complete two semesters of approved service learning, such as a course with at least 20 hours of service, an internship or a study abroad program, with one at the 2000 level or above.
Applicants to the Academy must receive an official nomination from a U.S. Representative or U.S. Senator from their state of residence.
During Sea Year in sophomore and junior years, midshipmen are assigned to commercial U.S.-flag merchant vessels, visiting an average of 18 foreign countries.

Tuition, room, board and medical care are free, and cadets are paid a salary. In return, graduates serve at least five years on active duty plus three in the reserves. You can't be admitted without a nomination, usually from a member of Congress or the Vice President, so start in the spring of junior year.
SAT and ACT scores aren't considered at all, even if you send them, like the rest of the University of California.

California residents from families earning under $100,000 who qualify for aid have UC's system-wide tuition and fees covered through the Blue and Gold Opportunity Plan; filing the FAFSA or California Dream Act Application is how you're considered.
UC Merced guarantees on-campus housing for two years to first-year students and for one year to transfer students who meet application deadlines.
The UCA Commitment covers tuition and academic fees for incoming Arkansas first-time undergraduate students who are Pell-eligible or have an annual household income of $100,000 or less.
Students can spend a semester living and studying at Harlaxton College, the university's 100-room Victorian manor in England.
First- and second-year students can join faculty research through UROP; about 1,100 students work with more than 700 researchers.

The Missouri Land Grant covers tuition and mandatory fees for incoming first-year Missouri residents who are Pell Grant-eligible and enroll full-time. It's awarded automatically; file the FAFSA by the priority deadline.

Students at 14 partner North Carolina community colleges can join 49erNext, which guarantees admission to UNC Charlotte once they finish an eligible associate degree with the required GPA, plus library and campus access while they're still at community college.

Through the Quaker Commitment, families earning under $200,000 get aid covering at least full tuition, as long as they have no more than $50,000 in cash and investments, no business or farm, and no real estate beyond their home.
USC Aiken is South Carolina's member of COPLAC, the Council of Public Liberal Arts Colleges.

Through the South Dakota Advantage tuition program, residents of 11 neighboring states—Colorado, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Wisconsin, and Wyoming—pay the same reduced tuition rate as South Dakota in-state residents.
The For Utah Scholarship guarantees four years of covered tuition and mandatory fees for Pell-eligible Utah residents.
For Pell-eligible Wisconsin residents, Bucky's Pell Pathway goes further: grants, scholarships and work-study that meet full financial need, including housing and food, for four years.
All full-time on-campus students at Valley City State University are issued either a MacBook Air or a Windows-based laptop.
Founded in 1882, Virginia State University is a historically Black university and one of Virginia's two land-grant institutions.

WashU doesn't include loans in aid offers for any admitted undergraduate. Through the WashU Pledge, first-years from Missouri or 53 Illinois counties with family income of $75,000 or less get tuition, fees, housing and food covered for four years.
Every U.S. citizen and permanent resident who enrolls gets a full-tuition scholarship, worth more than $250,000 over four years.

Wellesley students can cross-register for classes at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Babson College, Brandeis University, and Olin College of Engineering, with access to dual-degree engineering programs.

Under its All-Grant financial aid program, Williams eliminates all student loans and work-study requirements from financial aid packages, replacing them with institutional grants that do not need to be repaid.
Williams provides a Book Grant that covers the full cost of all required textbooks and course materials for every student receiving financial aid.
